request.style: English, cinematic orchestral, deep baritone male soloist with full mixed choir, strings, French horns, low brass, harp, timpani, awe-filled and majestic, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Beyond the wilderness he led the flock of Jethro on
To Horeb, the mountain of God, where the desert wind had blown
A bush was blazing in the rocks and still it was not burned
He turned aside to see the sight, and God called as he turned
Moses, Moses
Here I am

[Chorus]
Take off your sandals
For the place where you are standing is holy ground
I AM WHO I AM
I AM has sent me to you

[Verse]
I have surely seen the misery of my people in Egypt
I have heard them crying out
I know their sufferings
So I have come down to rescue them
Into a good and spacious land
A land flowing with milk and honey

[Chorus]
Take off your sandals
For the place where you are standing is holy ground
I AM WHO I AM
I AM has sent me to you

[Bridge]
Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh
I will be with you
The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob
This is my name forever
From generation to generation

[Chorus]
Take off your sandals
For the place where you are standing is holy ground
I AM WHO I AM
I AM has sent me to you

[Outro]
Holy ground
